name: planning-poker-protocol
description: Facilitate a planning poker estimation session. Produces session agenda, facilitator guide, per-item estimation template (description → silent card selection → reveal → outlier discussion → re-vote → consensus), Fibonacci card set, anti-anchoring rules, and outcome log (final estimate + discussion notes + open questions per item). Two modes: facilitation (live session structure) and documentation (record completed session). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
